title: matelea schreiteri
intro: Matelea schreiteri, commonly known as the "Vine of the Soul" or "Soul Vine", is a plant species belonging to the Apocynaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues, including anxiety, depression, and insomnia, thanks to its reported health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Matelea schreiteri are attributed to its ability to act as a sedative, anxiolytic, and hypnotic, allowing it to promote relaxation and improve sleep quality. The bioactive constituents of Matelea schreiteri include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
